scopeNotes: This immutable object is produced by the fixed production root observer. It is a current registration/file observation, never a transferable grant or lifetime authority. No pairing/license state is read or changed by this read-only module.

Raw LaunchServices URL/canonical paths accept only the explicit /var to /private/var system alias. Interior symlinks are rejected through descriptor traversal; the old Darwin resolver is a before/after cross-check, not the only authority.

Captured main and embedded executable/plist bytes are hashed through held descriptors with stable metadata, path/inode, ownership, mode, ACL and link checks. Final relevant extension membership is repeated. Independent shell SHA comparisons validate specified file contents and do not prove descriptor lifetime or process admission.
Installation UUIDs are distinct semantic namespaces from legacy numeric CIDs and source configuration UUIDs; none is substituted for another.

The 30-second deadline is cooperative: blocking LaunchServices/regular-file reads cannot be cancelled by this library. Descriptor byte accounting excludes separate bounded legacy-resolver metadata reads. No hard watchdog or synchronous transaction lifetime claim is made.

Registration plus file digests does not authenticate Apple/Meta publisher signatures or loaded Frameworks/dylibs/resources. Optional non-executable embedded binaries are inventoried only; no extension launch is accepted.

Only main-app registered data/group URL metadata and declaration counts were observed. Directory contents, other extensions, shared writers and signed entitlements were not audited. The metadata remains UNVERIFIED and grants no storage authority.
Owner app/helpers/daemon/engine/presentation were not installed or changed. Private app installation identifiers/paths/digests, group names, raw reports and tooling remain outside Git.
